title.narrative: Empowering Internally Displaced Persons and Youth through Vocational Training and Livelihood Support in Cameroon

description.narrative: 300 beneficiaries trained in craft-related fields. 50 beneficiaries trained in the installation and maintenance of solar energy systems and hydraulic infrastructure. Delivery of 350 in-kind grants. 300 beneficiaries trained in entrepreneurship skills. Establishment of 20 collective professional business groups.
Providing economic empowerment opportunities for vulnerable groups, especially youth and women among internally displaced persons in the Far North region of Cameroon.
Strengthen community resilience and stability through: 1) Providing vocational training and in-kind grants, 2) Building entrepreneurship capacity and supporting small businesses.

Disbursement for "Empowering Internally Displaced Persons and Youth through Vocational Training and Livelihood Support in Cameroon" in Cameroon, implemented by United Nations Development Programme (UNDP)
